programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Guests and employees of Hall Place have witnessed furniture moving on its own and apparitions of Civil War Union Soldiers ambling through the halls. The tunnels beneath were reportedly used for the underground railroad.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Jerry Stiller, Mindy McCready, Nick Hogan, Lourdes Benedicto
programme.desc: Jerry Stiller receives a long awaited message from his father; a maternal figure appears to Mindy McCready at one of the darkest moments of her life.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Mindy Cohn, Valerie Harper, Matthew Gray-Gubler, Nicole Eggert
programme.desc: Looking for the perfect sanctuary to finish her book, Mindy Cohn is confronted with anything but solitude at a famous Pasadena apartment building; while at a crossroads.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Kentucky is home to a slew of purportedly haunted locations, with some that are more notorious than others. By all local accounts, the Benton farmhouse should be considered one of the state’s most significant haunts.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: En revisor fra skattevæsenet bliver pludselig genstand for en fortælling, som kun han selv kan høre: en fortælling, der begynder at påvirke hele hans liv, fra hans arbejde til hans kærlighed til hans død.

programme.title: The Cider House Rules
programme.desc: Den Oscar®-vindende publikumsfavorit om en mand, der søger efter et tilhørssted. Filmatiseret af bestsellerromanen, John Irvings stærke lektion om livet, kærlighed og hjemmet fik ros af kritikere og biografgæster over alt.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: An armed robbery is a terrifying ordeal. When a gang descended on a Los Angeles cash vault, they threatened to kill anyone who resisted. The violent assault was the largest heist in U.S. history and a piece of plastic was the only evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: Oscar®-vinderen*, Charlize Theron, spiller Aeon Flux, som er en undergrundsagent, der kæmper mod det totalitære styre i Jordens sidste, levende by i det 25. århundrede.

programme.title: Angreb! Er det bedste forsvar
programme.desc: To snobbede millionærer fra Rio de Janeiro bliver udsat for pengeafpresning. Heldigvis møder de Elliott Vance (Terence Hill) og Greg Wonder (Bud Spencer), som ligner dem på en prik, og de hyrer dem for en tid som stand-ins.

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: Tre mænd genoplever deres sorgløse collegetid ved at dræbe så mange hjerneceller, de kan, i denne forskruede komedie. Mitch kommer hjem fra en mindre behagelig forretningsrejse og afslører sin kone Heidi midt i en trekant.

programme.title: Ernest in the Army
programme.desc: Ernest melder sig til hæren, så han kan køre store lastbiler, men ender med at blive sendt i krig! Bemærk denne film vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: New Yorker-parret Josh og Cornelia er begge i 40’erne. Alderskrisen kradser, så da de møder et ungt hipster-par, Jamie og Darby, skiftes parmiddage ud med rulleskøjter, jazzhat og hip-hop-timer.

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Efter en romantisk aften i deres afsides hus vågner Emma lænket til sin døde mand. Hun er fanget, afskåret fra omverdenen og må kæmpe mod lejemordere for at undslippe sin mands forskruede plan.

programme.title: The Place Beyond the Pines
programme.desc: En motorcyklist påbegynder et liv med kriminalitet for at kunne forsørge sønnen, som han ikke vidste, han havde. Han bliver i mellemtiden forfulgt af en idealistisk politimand.

programme.title: Det Handler Om Henry
programme.desc: Henry er en succesrig advokat, der altid vil vinde, også selvom det går ud over familien. Et enkelt skud sætter dog en stopper for Henrys karriere og efterlader ham ude af stand til at tage vare på sig selv og uden erindring om livet, han levede før.

programme.title: That Touch Of Mink
programme.desc: Kærlighed, der fejer benene væk under dig! En smuk og eftertragtet godsejer og en smuk arbejderklassekvinde mødes over en vandpyt på fortovet. Han er betaget af hendes småbyliv, og hun er fascineret af hans romantiske manerer.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Smoking Gun
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel leder efter Al Capones diamantbesatte pistol på foranledning af en mand, der håber, at den vil rense hans bedstefar for et mord, som han blev sat i bås for.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Affaire de Coeur
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel tager til Skotland for at finde den anden ring i Calums og Elenas par af Twining Rings.

programme.title: Andromeda: Double Helix

programme.title: Andromeda: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon
programme.desc: En slipstream sender Andromeda tilbage i tiden til lige før Commonwealths fald. Besætningen må gribe ind for at bevare historien.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Three hairs, microscopic fibers, a common trash bag ripped from a roll. Seemingly small and insignificant clues become a victim's silent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Lauded as “The Mecca of Paranormal Investigation”, Waverly Hills is purportedly home to spirits who are not shy to interact with visitors who frequent its massive halls, with decades’ worth of inexplicable finds documented by various investigators.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: One of Tennessee''s most respected thoroughbred horse farms, the Rose Mont was built by Judge "Jo" Conn Guild, where his family resided for generations. Today, it operates as a wedding and event venue where guests have claimed to spot apparitions.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Joan Rivers, David Carradine, Scott Baio, Teri Polo
programme.desc: Joan Rivers asks a voodoo priestess to help her with an angry ghost.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Barry Williams, Debi Mazar, Greg Grunberg, Sammy Hagar
programme.desc: When Barry Williams holds a memorial service for his father, a few strange "happenings" make the day even more unforgettable; Debi Mazer gets a hostile welcome from a ghost when she moves into a friend's home.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Carrie Fisher, Rue McClanahan, John Waters, Federico Castelluccio
programme.desc: Carrie Fisher has a spooky experience after her best friend dies in her bed; John Waters still remembers a scary night in the woods back in the 1950s.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African-American horror film.

programme.title: Opera DA
programme.desc: Da en berømt operadiva kommer til skade i en færdselsulykke, får hendes suppleant Betty chancen for at vise sine evner. Betty får straks succes, men lærer snart om stjernelivets bagsider, da en beundrer vil ind på livet af hende.

programme.title: The Immigrant
programme.desc: New York, 1921. Den polske kvinde Ewa sejler til Amerika i jagten på et nyt liv. Her møder hun den charmerende, men ondskabsfulde mand Bruno, der presser hende ud i prostitution. Men tryllekunstneren Orlando kan blive hendes håb og redning fra Bruno.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: Fra John Travoltas fængslende og Oscarnominerede præstation til Bee Gees succes-soundtrack og de uforglemmelige dansetrin - "Saturday Night Fever" er en filmsensation, der fangede verdens opmærksomhed som aldrig før.

programme.title: County Line
programme.desc: Alden Rockwell, der er sherif og tidligere marinesoldat, er ved at finde sig til rette i en uønsket pension, da hans gamle krigskammerat og nabosherif bliver skudt på mystisk vis.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Den talentfulde hasardspiller Michael har syv dage til at betale et større beløb til en skruppelløs virksomhed, eller han bliver likvideret. Han samler derfor et team af individer med overnaturlige evner for at score kassen på et kasino.

programme.title: Patrick
programme.desc: Sarah Francis er en ung kvinde, hvis liv er noget værre rod. Det sidste, hun har brug for, er en anden, hun skal tage sig af. Men uanset om hun kan lide det eller ej, har hendes bedstemor ladet sin meget forkælede hund, mopsen Patrick, gå i arv til hende.

programme.title: Waiting . . .
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds, Anna Ferris og Justin Long serverer grinene som unge tjenere og servitricer, der søger en mening med livet, kærligheden og venskabet i denne forrygende komedie.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina
programme.desc: Josie er en marketingchef, som vender tilbage til sin hjemby, da hun uventet bliver værge for sin niece og nevø. Mens hun er der, genoptager hun kontakten med Cooper, hendes ungdomskæreste.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: En tyv med en unik, professionel etik bliver bedraget af sin bande og efterladt til at dø. I en ny forklædning, og i en alliance med en kvinde, leder han efter bandens seneste udbytte fra et kup.

programme.title: Halloween III: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: En ond legetøjsfabrikant planlægger at sælge millioner af masker, som vil dræbe alle de børn, der bærer dem til Halloween.

programme.title: Andromeda: Båndene der blinder
programme.desc: Besætningen besvarer et nødopkald og samler Beckas bror, som nu er Wayist, og hans ven op.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lethe-bankerne
programme.desc: Et sort hul giver Dylan mulighed for at kommunikere med sin tidligere forlovede 300 år tilbage i tiden.

programme.desc: Da en pest, der kun rammer mutanter, hærger, bliver Adam og Eckhart enige om at arbejde sammen for at finde en kur.

programme.title: Mutant X: Tændt sikring

programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The oldest, and longest running movie theatre in Kentucky is now owned and operated by someone who never once thought about ghosts. However, a shocking experience with a woman dressed in white altered his belief in the supernatural forever.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus från helvetet Promo
programme.desc: Kom in, om du vågar! Under dagen besöker vi spökjägare och extrema samlare, medan vi på kvällen skruvar upp kusligheterna med skräckfilm och kliver in de mest skrämmande spökhusen.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The screams of Cassius Clay in his final days can still be heard reverberating through the walls of White Hall. Caretakers have had their belief in the supernatural shifted ever since they began spending time at the site.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The Brennans’ legacy begins and ends in their enchanting Old Louisville home: nearly every member of the Brennan clan perished within its walls or had their funeral service held here.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Falling in Love: Falling in Love
programme.desc: Frank och Molly möts under julshopping. De flyktigt korta mötet börjar förändra deros liv när de känner igen varandra månader senare på tåget hem, och har en bra tid tillsammans.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerande berättelse om basketcoachen Ken Carter, som fick både kritik och beröm när han skapade rubriker efter att han bänkat hela sitt obesegrade lag på grund av deras dåliga studieresultat.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1990s, neighborhoods in Detroit were terrorized by a gang of robbers. Impersonating police officers, they invaded over 100 homes robbing, raping and torturing their victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: Tommy har förtjänat sitt diplom och ett jobb på Callahan Auto Parts. Men familjeföretaget börjar gå dåligt, och nu måste Tommy ge sig ut på resa med sin pappas högra hand, en självbelåten siffertuggare.

programme.title: The Bad News Bears
programme.desc: Ett gäng klumpiga, basebollspelande juniorer med en en elvaårig tjej som fuskande kastare, tränas av en komisk, ölpimplande, för detta medioker basebollspelare, som leder dem till mästerskap.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Efter terrorattackerna den 11 september utser kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg till att leda kompensationsfonden för offren. Feinberg står nu inför en omöjlig uppgift - att avgöra vad ett liv är värt.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: 1968 anländer Judy Garland till London för en rad utsålda konserter. Utåt charmar Judy alla med sin värme och karisma, men inuti är hon djupt ärrad av ett liv i rampljuset och en tuff vårdnadstvist.

programme.title: A Breath Of Scandal
programme.desc: Den vackra Sophia Loren är den österrikiska prinsessan som, trots sin exil från familjegården, föraktar sin mors önskan att gifta sig med en prins.

programme.title: The Private Life Of Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: When a beautiful woman claims that her husband has disappeared, the investigation takes Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson to Scotland, where they uncover a plot involving a clandestine society, Her Majesty's Secret Service... and the Loch Ness Monster!

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Gå inte in i skogen
programme.desc: Sydneys vän ringer för att berätta att han har hittat information om Maribors gyllene hök, som varit försvunnen sedan 1711. Sydney och Nigel reser till Lubjanka för att träffa honom, men han är redan borta.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Midnattsflygning
programme.desc: Germania, ca. 400 e.Kr.: En artefakt som kallas Gunthers spira är förseglad i ett kassavalv. Kleine Burgh, 2001: Sydney och Nigel anlitas för att hitta den med hjälp av en kristall och en stentavla.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bunkernkulle
programme.desc: Dylan och hans nya flotta från Samväldet tar sig an Drago-Kazovs flotta men finner den mycket större än väntat.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ouroboros
programme.desc: Magog-äggen i Harper börjar kläckas, så teamet bygger en Teseract-maskin.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: Opera

programme.title: Wrong Turn At Tahoe

programme.title: Spelets Regler
programme.desc: En man ansluter sig till den politiska kampanjen för en manipulativ kandidat till president i USA.

programme.title: Beautiful Boy
programme.desc: Den framgångsrike journalisten David har alltid försökt ge sin älskade son allt han behöver. Men vare sig David eller Nics mamma Vicki kan hindra sonen från att börja experimentera med crystal meth.

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Ett kapat flygplan kommer att krascha om bara 97 minuter när bränslet tar slut. NSA-chefen vill att planet ska skjutas ner innan dess och lämnar de oskyldiga passagerarnas öde i händerna på en hemlig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: Walking Tall
programme.desc: Baserad på livet av sheriff Buford Pusser från Tennessee, som på egen hand rensade upp brottslighet och korruption i sin lilla stad, men på bekostnad av sitt familjeliv och nästan sitt eget liv.

programme.title: Tetsuo II: Body Hammer
programme.desc: Tre år efter Metal Fetischistens förvandling ser kontorsarbetaren Taniguchi Tomoo världen krascha när skinheads kidnappar hans son. Tvungen att släppa lös sin destruktiva kraft, förvandlas han till en grym symbios av metall och vävnad.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lava och raketer
programme.desc: Dylan tar över en turistbåt i ett försök att undkomma legosoldater.

programme.title: Andromeda: Var alla mina synder ihåg
programme.desc: En identifiering av en kropp går snett när det visar sig att Bekas tidigare besättningskamrat inte är död.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Grift
programme.desc: Brennans skumma före detta flickvän vänder sig till honom för att få hjälp när hennes senaste bluff tar en dödlig vändning.

programme.title: Mutant X: Vid ödets slut
programme.desc: Teamet står inför sitt farligaste uppdrag hittills: att stoppa en grupp ekoterrorister.

programme.title: Mutant X: Inom dessa väggar
programme.desc: Brennan är upprörd över Adam, som berättar att han anförtrotts att hålla en hemlighet och lämnar efter att ha pratat med den personen. Mannen letar efter någon och är villig att döda vem som helst för att komma åt den personen.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry

programme.title: The New Detectives: Death Grip

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Impo-Dent

programme.title: RENO 911!: Fastest Criminal in Reno

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Secret Girlfriend

programme.title: Byzantium

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Monsters are Due on Maple Street

programme.title: Fredagen den 13:e del 6: Fredagen den 13:e del VI - Jason lever
programme.desc: Som barn lyckades Tommy Jarvis med det som kostade många andra livet när de försökte. Han dödade Jason Voorhees, massmördaren som terroriserade invånarna i Crystal Lake. Men flera år senare är Tommy rädd att Jason kanske trots allt lever.

programme.title: Fredagen den 13:e del 7
programme.desc: Ända sen mordiske galningen Jason Voorhees fångades i kedjor på botten av sjön Crystal Lake, har sommarlägret i närheten fungerat utan problem... utan mord. Men en av den här säsongens glada lägerdeltagare har tagit med en dödlig hemlighet.

programme.title: Fredagen den 13:e del 4

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Innkeeper and Quarantine
programme.desc: A boy tells his babysitter that a man called "The Keeper" visits his room in the night. A recovering addict realizes the visions he's seeing at a remote cabin are not hallucinations.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Under the Porch and Bruises
programme.desc: A young girl discovers horrific sculptures made of bones under her family's new house. Thunderstorms unleash violent paranormal activity in a young woman's home.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Roommate and Chain Letter
programme.desc: A psychiatrist questions her own sanity when her patient's "roommate" begins appearing in her house. A young woman realizes that threats made in anonymous chain letters are coming true.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Unknown Caller and The Rocking Chair
programme.desc: A woman receives terrifying phone messages from an unknown caller who seems to be watching her every move. A baby goes missing after a couple brings an antique rocking chair into their home.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Kendra Wilkinson
programme.desc: Kendra Wilkinson (The Girls Next Door, Kendra on Top) is desperate to know what or who was behind the paranormal encounters she had at her former home in Pasadena, CA.

programme.title: Theater Of Blood
programme.desc: Vincent Price, in a role both madcap and touching, stars as an actor taking vengeance on the critics who fail to appreciate his genius, killing them in a series of murders based on Shakespeare. Diana Rigg plays Price’s Cordelia-like daughter.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Duncans brutalt uttråkade flickvän Annie har aldrig insett Crowes storhet. Ett oväntat snedsteg leder till att Annie och Duncan gör slut, samtidigt som en oslipad version av Tucker Crowes mest kända album kommer ut.

programme.title: I'm Not There
programme.desc: Bob Dylan gestaltas i denna film av vitt skilda skådespelare i en serie av sammanvävda historier. Resultatet är en vacker hyllning till Dylan och hans musik samt en inblick i en musikalisk enstörings liv, som både fans och nybörjare kan glädjas över.

programme.title: Occupation: Rainfall
programme.desc: Den mycket efterlängtade uppföljaren till ”Occupation”, en sleeper-hit från 2018. Två år efter den intergalaktiska invasionen och ockupation av jorden slår de överlevande styrkorna tillbaka i ett desperat markkrig.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En erfaren lönnmördare får problem när han blir kär i sitt mål, en charmig svindlare som inte tänker gå ner utan en fight.

programme.title: L.A. Gigolo
programme.desc: en unga och charmerande Nicki (Ashton Kutcher) lever ett liv som enbart de snyggaste kan drömma om. Han svindlar till sig en luxuös livsstil genom att tillfredställa rika kvinnor i sängen – och han är djävulskt bra på det!

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: När tre banditer tar en framstående läkare i staden som gisslan på jakt efter en försvunnen kvinna kallas sheriff Watts in för att hantera situationen innan FBI anländer.

programme.title: Bronson
programme.desc: Charles Bronson, född Michael Peterson, är Englands mest våldsbenägne intern. Redan som barn drömde han om att bli berömd, men visste inte för vad tills den dagen han rånade ett postkontor.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: När Jack Deebs var bakom galler fann han verklighetsflykt genom att skapa Cool World, en tecknad serie om en ragata som heter Holli Would. Köttet är dock svagare än bläcket, då Holli tar mänsklig form i Las Vegas.

programme.title: Cary Grant - Första gången jag såg dig
programme.desc: Bitterljuvt drama om hopp och förtvivlan

programme.title: Mutant X: Hard Time
programme.desc: Teamet går under täckmantel för att undersöka oförklarliga dödsfall i ett fängelse.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Bödelns mask
programme.desc: När en modell blir vanställd i ansiktet efter att ha tagit på sig en fransk bödelmasker försöker Sydney och Nigel hitta graven för att vända förbannelsen.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Den kungliga ringen
programme.desc: När British Museum ber Sidney och Nigel att hjälpa till att leta efter en ring av kung Henrik VIII på Tudor-platser konfronteras Nigel med sin självsäkra, pestande storebror Preston Bailey.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Satt i sten
programme.desc: I ett kloster spetsar riddare Gabriel en demon som förvandlas till sten. År 2001 anländer Nigel och Sydney med ett brev från en munk, men abboten hävdar att det är en förfalskning och stänger ute dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Tidsfrist
programme.desc: Allan kommer till Sydney och berättar att han har 12 timmar på sig innan ett Necron-virus dödar honom om han inte levererar Tau till en utpressare som har motgiftet.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Michelin Man helps out... with his life! Crystar, the Crystal Warrior, gets smoked! Thelma and Louise regret their suicidal ways. The Maytag Repairman's life REALLY sucks. The Laff-A-Lympics gang face their darkest games ever: Munich, 1972.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Kool-Aid Man quenches some inconvenient thirsts. The mystery of why Encyclopedia Brown's parents aren't getting along. What new realm will D&D's Venger conquer next? programme.desc: Strange happenings occur to some friends before a birthday party in a large warehouse. Two of them find an old spirit board and they decide to contact the dead victim former tenants...

programme.title: Dead End Demon (aka Dead End 2)
programme.desc: It has been almost 2 years since the small town of Santa Carla had suffered in the hands of the raging maniac, Cameron Crowe. Legend around town had it as that he may have been burnt in a fire he started...

programme.title: Dinosaur Hotel 2
programme.desc: Surviving contestants are reunited in the ultimate game to win 10 million dollars. Only one contestant will survive and claim the prize as the others fall to the dinosaurs...

programme.title: The Leprechaun's Game
programme.desc: After a bunch of thieves are sent out to hunt for urban legends by a wealthy man intending to open a museum full of mythical creatures. Soon, the thieves will learn the legend of a Leprechaun...

programme.title: The Body Tree
programme.desc: When a group of Americans travels to Russian Siberia to honor the memory of their murdered friend, they uncover a plot that threatens all their lives...

programme.title: Scarecrow's Revenge
programme.desc: A Viking Warrioress must step up when a heathen, banished from her village gives up his mortal soul in exchange for the near indestructible form of a demonic Scarecrow. As warriors fall to the vengeful Scarecrow, it's down to Greta to save her village from annihilation...

programme.title: Shutter
programme.desc: A supernatural stalker pursues a super model to steal her soul with his demonic camera...

programme.title: The Mermaid's Curse
programme.desc: A young man falls in love with a seductive, sultry, young woman he meets on the beach. The more he falls for her, the more he will learn the dangers of falling in love with a siren...

programme.title: Ditch Day
programme.desc: Jenny Bilson, a high school senior, is the perfect student, a wonderful daughter to a veteran police detective and an all American Dream. But the one mistake she is unaware of making is about to haunt her in a very violent way, as her past returns for revenge...

programme.title: American Beast (aka Beast of Prey)
programme.desc: After finding an old storage locker filled with his family's history, James Erikson begins a journey to discover the truth behind a mysterious piece of land in the small town of Solitude...

programme.title: Die In One Day
programme.desc: After a failed marriage, Richard is in search of his daughter Mindy. He meets Sasha, an aspiring actress who promises to help him. But the hope to get some quick cash by performing in a 24 hours play soon turns out to be a bloody game...

programme.title: The Midnight Man
programme.desc: Hoping to fix their dysfunctional marriage, a couple travels to an isolated mountain cabin to work out their problems - but the one problem they didn't anticipate is the maniac trying to kill them...

programme.title: Alp
programme.desc: After a traumatic experience, Chris comes home to confront his past. but soon finds himself prey to a Demon who taunts him through sleep paralysis...

programme.title: Camp Massacre
programme.desc: Ten obese men appear on a competitive reality show geared toward weight-loss. As contestants disappear in the night it becomes apparent that a killer is on the loose...

programme.title: Creature in the Dark
programme.desc: After strange creatures arrive, a husband waiting for the return of his wife, must adjust to being sole caretaker of his young daughter, while dealing with what is in his basement...

programme.title: Baby Doll
programme.desc: A group of student in vacation find themselves in a house where strange rituals were performed. The sudden finding of a doll bring the group on a downward spiral...

programme.title: Blue Hour
programme.desc: Olivia Brandreth was nine years old when her father disappeared. Twenty five years later, she has returned to her childhood home to finally get closure in an unrelenting attempt to set the record straight...

programme.title: The Elevator (ITN)
programme.desc: A reporter discovers all is not as it seems at an infamous hotel...

programme.title: Horror High 2020 Tyler J. Case
programme.desc: A monster lurks around a high school in the hypnotized town of Willow Hills and picks off tardy students one by one. Now it is up to an unlikely group of teens to put an end to the terror that has plagued many...

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 10 - One Takedown from Glory
programme.desc: Ken Shamrock’s Iron Man competition comes to a head as two contestants battle it out for the number one spot. Every strike, every takedown matters—because only one can walk away crowned the victor. But there’s no time to celebrate. It’s mission day. After a quick live-fire break, the team receives critical intel from the ISR daylight crew. The risk spikes as night falls and the mission is suddenly altered, forcing the contestants to adapt on the fly. With Red Cat providing coordination from above, the squad is redeployed under new marching orders and even higher stakes. A partially compromised team makes survival uncertain, but when the moment of truth arrives, the team leader takes decisive action—leading a direct breach on the target. One bold decision shifts the course of the mission entirely, and its success now hangs by a thread.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 11 - Surviving Mann Faces Off
programme.desc: With the mission complete, the contestants think the season is winding down—but HQ has other plans. Their once-fabricated cover story becomes reality, pulling them into a pulse-pounding new challenge designed to test strength, coordination, and mastery of weaponry. This hybrid competition pushes every skill to the limit, weeding out all but the most well-rounded tactical athletes. Along the way, the legendary Don Mann shares his own backstory, giving rare insight into the life and mindset of the man behind the mission. When the dust settles, only one competitor will rise above the rest—earning the title of the season’s most complete warrior.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 12 - The Warrior’s Last Stand
programme.desc: The competition reaches its ultimate test as the Face-Off enters Phase Two. Contestants are pushed to their breaking points with a brutal mix of tactical and physical challenges—running and gunning through the forest, navigating five tactical evolutions, and grinding through five grueling physical trials, capped by a punishing two-mile run over unforgiving terrain. Along the way, Don reveals the origins of his legendary SEAL Adventure Challenge, the inspiration behind this ultimate proving ground. When one contestant’s body shuts down in shock, the resilience of the warrior mindset is put on full display in a dramatic fight to recover and press on. In this season finale, only the strongest will endure, but every competitor leaves forged by fire.

programme.title: The Fight Beyond Survival
programme.desc: Season 4 begins with a mission focused on combating human trafficking as Don Mann, Jeff Tiegs, Sheriff Mark Lamb and Jenn Stankus introduce contestants with powerful reasons to compete.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 4 Ep. 2 - Paintball on Steroids
programme.desc: With the brutal PRT finally behind them, the contestants shift into full mission-training mode. Tactical intensity ramps up fast as UTM’s Tony Lambraia introduces force-on-force training ammunition described as “paintball on steroids,” preparing the team for the realities of close-quarters tactics and high-pressure scenarios. As training escalates, the mission becomes deeply personal. Skull Games continues its fight against the growing crisis of sex trafficking in America, targeting predators where they operate most: online. Contestant and survivor AnnMarie shares her powerful story of resilience, while the founder of Fireborn speaks on helping women escape abuse and reclaim their lives. Jeff Tiegs leads the team through a knife-fighting course with Hinderer Knives, emphasizing the critical importance of the OODA Loop observe, orient, decide, act. And just as the contestants begin to find their rhythm, a chilling mission warning order changes everything.

programme.title: The Big Reveal S1 Ep. 1 - Kicking Off With A Jolt
programme.desc: Compliant Technologies unveils a new safety device, Kevin Harrington meets the team behind Unlock Math, and Sheriff Mark Lamb explores systems designed to streamline off-duty police coordination.

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 2 - Three Entrepreneurs Walk Into a Bar...
programme.desc: The Big Reveal does it again by bringing three very different entrepreneurs together, all connected by their pioneer spirit. Flag Guard tips off this episode by explaining how they’re doing their part in keeping your loved ones safe. After that, Dr. West explains how his revolutionary probiotic will fix your digestive health 100% of the time. Host Kevin Harrington then caps off this episode in style with a trip to Tommasina Eyewear’s studio with a peak behind the curtain.

programme.title: We’re off to a Rocky Start
programme.desc: In the last episode, Kyle took to the skies; now it’s the seas. Co-host Josh Peterson joins Kyle on a deep sea fishing excursion that ends in one of them losing their lunch.. but who will it be? Later (after everyone’s cleaned up) the gang reconvenes for a legendary course of fire with some serious artillery… and Bob.

programme.title: The Insect Expert Does Grassroots Marketing
programme.desc: Kevin Harrington and Toli Cefail tackle growth with Advanced Vitality, Scout & Zoe’s insect-based pet treats, Hammer Haag Steel and Zenith Trek.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 1 - Surviving Mann Goes International
programme.desc: A group of 5 All Star contestants were chosen to embark on an adventure overseas, but what they didn’t know is that it would become a maritime mission. Radio Host Kerri Kasem and rockstar Ashba join Don as he breaks the news to the contestants that there’s more to this yacht than a pleasure cruise. If they thought that this trip was going to be smooth sailing, they soon realized how mistaken they were when Don hit them with the hardest physical evolution in Surviving Mann’s history.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 2 - When the CIA Calls…
programme.desc: When the CIA calls, the All-Stars answer. The team is tasked with sabotaging a drug-smuggling boat before it can make its shipment. With mission success hanging in the balance, the All-Stars take their training up a notch, starting with a lesson in maritime navigation. From there, the contestants practice their tactical cast and turtleback swimming, but things take a turn when the contestants partake in a mile race against the current. Who will win and prove their water proficiency?

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 1 Ep. 1 - Survival Of The Toughest
programme.desc: Surviving Mann Season 1 thrilled with challenges, adventure and good old-fashioned American determination. But, before season 2 arrives, we have a new challenge for the best of the best. In All-Stars the top 3 Surviving Mann contestants will face off against 3 special operations veterans in a 48-hour no-sleep battle of endurance and willpower. Starting with a kayak, portage and run challenge, it’s time to discover if these top contestants are worthy of the name All-Stars.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 1 Ep. 2 - Hold The Blah Line
programme.desc: The challenges have only gotten started. In episode two, the two teams must go beyond their limits to come out on top. From the brutal Blah line to chopping down trees with only a small ax, it’s a battle for points that’ll take immense willpower to see to the end.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 4 Ep. 3 - Eyes in the Sky
programme.desc: With the human trafficking mission warning order in effect, preparation shifts into high gear. Don Mann wastes no time putting the team through one of his signature challenges: a brutal log PT evolution over unforgiving terrain. Hauling a massive log over rocks, under vehicles, and even up a tree, the contestants quickly learn that teamwork and determination can turn the impossible into reality. As mission readiness becomes the focus, the team gets a look at cutting-edge equipment from Flux Defense and the technology that could make all the difference in the field. The action heats up when Genesis Arms demonstrates specialized anti-drone weaponry, turning the sky into a showcase of explosive precision. But the real challenge begins when the contestants pair up for sniper hide construction In a mission where staying hidden could mean everything, the contestants discover that sometimes the best way to survive is to never be seen at all.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 4 Ep. 4 - Shield and Strike
programme.desc: The mission draws closer as the contestants sharpen their close-quarters combat skills with an intense day of tactical training. Under the guidance of the UTM team, they learn the fundamentals of clearing floor plans before progressing to high-stress scenarios involving moving targets, where speed, communication, and decision-making are put to the test. Next, TC Burton unveils an armored vehicle designed to enhance the team’s mission capabilities, while Gear Head Works introduces a telescoping brace system that improves weapon control and reduces fatigue under load. The day concludes with one-handed shooting drills behind a ballistic shield, a demanding exercise that challenges contestants to maintain accuracy and composure while operating under protection. As mission day approaches, the contestants learn that mastering tactics is only half the battle. The real challenge is performing when every second counts.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 4 Ep. 5 - Hide and Seek
programme.desc: With mission day rapidly approaching, the contestants enter the zero-hour phase of their preparation. Outfitted by G-Code Tactical with mission-ready holsters and gear, the team takes on a demanding course of fire designed to sharpen speed, accuracy, and confidence under pressure. The training intensifies as Vets Tactical, a veteran-owned company, introduces force-on-force vehicle scenarios that challenge contestants to make split-second decisions in dynamic environments. Next, Conflict Kinetics raises the bar with a course of fire that tests far more than marksmanship. From memory recall to trigger discipline and decision-making under stress, contestants must prove they can think and perform when the pressure is at its peak. The day culminates in a high-stakes sniper hide challenge. Using the concealed positions they built earlier in the season, contestants must remain undetected long enough to get a single shot off before Don Mann finds them. If they succeed, they earn the victory. If Don spots them first, there will be consequences.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 4 Ep. 6 - Rescue Under Fire
programme.desc: Red Cat thermal drones hunt the hidden snipers before one final force-on-force evolution gives way to the real mission: rescuing a child from human traffickers.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 1 Ep. 1 - He Said Do What?
programme.desc: Don Mann puts 32 elite contestants through their first punishing tests, quickly proving that even the best of the best have no idea what they’ve signed up for.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 1 Ep. 2 - Embrace The Suck
programme.desc: Don reveals that the contestants’ opening challenge was only a cover story, raising the stakes as the real mission begins to take shape.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 1 Ep. 3 - Let The Games Begin
programme.desc: The 32 face new weapons, cutting-edge gear and shooting challenges from Don Mann, where the strongest marksman may not be who anyone expects.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 1 Ep. 4 - The 50 Cal
programme.desc: Surprise PT gets even tougher as Don Mann and Randy Couture push the 32 to their limits before a .50-caliber challenge shakes up the competition lead.

programme.title: Fortress S1 Ep. 1 - Homesteads and Handguns
programme.desc: Sheriff Mark Lamb and the Fortress team explore security with purpose, from a homestead supporting trafficking survivors to CCW Safe’s legal protection for concealed carriers.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 1 - Liberty Locked & Loaded
programme.desc: Host Tim Harmsen kicks off Wild Shots with a coast-to-coast deep dive into American gun culture. From the first colonial settlement to Capitol Hill, he explores the origins of the Second Amendment and the modern fight to protect it. Along the way, he teams up with top firearms experts and puts iconic weapons to the test—including a brutal challenge to see just how many rounds it takes to break an AR-15.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 2 - 10,000 Rounds, No Mercy
programme.desc: Host Tim Harmsen teams up with SEAL Team 6 legend Don Mann to tackle real-world defense tactics and home-clearing techniques. A visit to Civil War battlefields connects history to modern freedoms, while the brutal 5-Year AR Challenge pushes an AR-15 through 10,000 rounds without cleaning. Will the rifle survive—or fail under fire?

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 3 - Drive, Draw, Defend
programme.desc: Tim Harmsen trains at Summit Point, testing rapid-fire shooting and vehicle combat tactics. At Fort Sumter, he reflects on the Civil War’s legacy with a 100-gun salute. Then it’s off to Avidity Arms, where Rob Pincus joins him to explore real-world home defense. From tactical holsters to high-speed vehicle drills, Tim puts it all to the test in a live-fire evolution under pressure.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 4 - Forged in Freedom, Built in America
programme.desc: Tim tours Palmetto State Armory, gives a battle-worn rifle a high-tech deep clean with SEAL 1 and joins Sootch for a 1,000-yard Wild Shot.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 5 - Microns, Myths, and Machine Guns
programme.desc: This episode of Wildshots kicks off in South Carolina, where Tim Harmsen goes behind the scenes at Jacob Grey Firearms for an inside look at precision craftsmanship in action. Known for their stunning 2011 pistols—true works of art—Jacob Grey takes perfection to the micron. From raw metal to “The Hex,” Tim witnesses how engineering meets artistry to create one of America’s most elite handguns.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 6 - Blades, Bullets, and Redneck Science
programme.desc: Tim heads to the Smoky Mountains for an action-packed adventure that’s as sharp as it gets. The journey kicks off at the world-famous Smoky Mountain Knife Works, the largest knife store on the planet, where Tim explores the artistry and precision behind the blades of We Knife. There, he reconnects with shooting legend Kyle Lamb, who shares his thoughts on the craftsmanship that keeps professionals equipped for anything. The action continues at Buds Gun Shop, where Tim joins Kyle once again to complete two of Lamb’s signature courses—the intense “Chaos Drill” and the dynamic “Triple Threat.” Together, they test speed, accuracy, and the mental discipline needed to master the range. But the day wouldn’t be complete without a little backwoods ingenuity. IraqVeteran8888 joins Tim for a bit of unconventional fun—combining creativity, curiosity, and some good old Redneck Science to wrap up an unforgettable episode.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 7 - Machines, Mastery, and the Wild Shot King
programme.desc: In this episode of Wildshots, host Tim Harmsen heads to Sig Sauer for an exclusive look inside one of America’s most advanced firearms manufacturing facilities. With a motto of “Every day you wake up and get a little better,” Sig Sauer lives up to its words—producing over 5,000 firearms a day with cutting-edge robotics and precision automation. After a full factory tour, Tim hits Sig’s state-of-the-art testing range to get hands-on with the legendary XM250 machine gun, pushing the limits of modern firepower. Then it’s time for some pure shooting mastery as Tim meets up with friend and firearms influencer 22Plinkster. Known for his unbelievable accuracy and showmanship, 22Plinkster ups the ante—splitting playing cards with a .22 bullet, upside down, and even splitting a single bullet mid-flight to hit two separate targets at once. Finally, the episode caps off with a nod to Hollywood as Tim checks out the Genesis Arms machinery seen in John Wick, blending cinematic cool with real-world firepower.

With a motto of “Every day you wake up and get a little better,” Sig Sauer lives up to its words—producing over 5,000 firearms a day with cutting-edge robotics and precision automation. After a full factory tour, Tim hits Sig’s state-of-the-art testing range to get hands-on with the legendary XM250 machine gun, pushing the limits of modern firepower. Then it’s time for some pure shooting mastery as Tim meets up with friend and firearms influencer 22Plinkster. Known for his unbelievable accuracy and showmanship, 22Plinkster ups the ante—splitting playing cards with a .22 bullet, upside down, and even splitting a single bullet mid-flight to hit two separate targets at once. Finally, the episode caps off with a nod to Hollywood as Tim checks out the Genesis Arms machinery seen in John Wick, blending cinematic cool with real-world firepower.

programme.title: First Engagement
programme.desc: Eight elite contestants begin a ten-event tactical decathlon testing endurance, shooting, speed and composure as they battle to prove who is the most complete competitor.

programme.title: Face Off S1 Ep. 2 - Obstacle by Obstacle
programme.desc: The contestants tackle obstacle courses, precision shooting and complex tasks under pressure, where every mistake costs time and every event brings the finals closer.

programme.title: Battle to the Finals
programme.desc: The pressure peaks as the contestants tackle the final events of the Tactical Decathlon, battling heavy obstacles, precision shooting, exhaustion and injury. After ten grueling events, four earn their place in the finals and make history by completing the first-ever Tactical Decathlon. But just when they think the night is over, Don has one more surprise waiting: a brutal PRT test involving a firehose. The road to the finals isn't over yet.

programme.title: The Ultimate Test
programme.desc: The final four go head-to-head with the championship on the line in the ultimate test of strength, endurance and tactical skill. They'll run, shoot, crawl through mud, battle through fire and push through pain as each fights to prove they have what it takes to become the ultimate champion. Then the worst weather of the competition hits, turning an already brutal finale into a battle against the elements. Four remain. Only one will emerge victorious.

programme.title: Fortress 1 Ep. 1 - Homesteads and Handguns
programme.desc: In the premiere of Fortress, Sheriff Mark Lamb and co-hosts explore America’s urgent need for security—both personal and societal. They meet a passionate team turning donated land into a homestead that feeds and shelters trafficking survivors. Then, CCW Safe steps in to showcase how legal protection for concealed carriers can be the line between justice and ruin. Powerful stories of resilience, protection, and purpose unfold in this compelling first episode.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 1 Ep. 2 - Hold The Blah Line
programme.desc: The challenges have only gotten started. In episode two, the two teams must go beyond their limits to come out on top. From the brutal Blah line to chopping down trees with only a small ax, it’s a battle for points that’ll take immense willpower to see to the end.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 1 - Surviving Mann Goes International
programme.desc: A group of 5 All Star contestants were chosen to embark on an adventure overseas, but what they didn’t know is that it would become a maritime mission. Radio Host Kerri Kasem and rockstar Ashba join Don as he breaks the news to the contestants that there’s more to this yacht than a pleasure cruise. If they thought that this trip was going to be smooth sailing, they soon realized how mistaken they were when Don hit them with the hardest physical evolution in Surviving Mann’s history.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 2 - When the CIA Calls…
programme.desc: When the CIA calls, the All-Stars answer. The team is tasked with sabotaging a drug-smuggling boat before it can make its shipment. With mission success hanging in the balance, the All-Stars take their training up a notch, starting with a lesson in maritime navigation. From there, the contestants practice their tactical cast and turtleback swimming, but things take a turn when the contestants partake in a mile race against the current. Who will win and prove their water proficiency?

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 1 Ep. 1 - Survival Of The Toughest
programme.desc: Surviving Mann Season 1 thrilled with challenges, adventure and good old-fashioned American determination. But, before season 2 arrives, we have a new challenge for the best of the best. In All-Stars the top 3 Surviving Mann contestants will face off against 3 special operations veterans in a 48-hour no-sleep battle of endurance and willpower. Starting with a kayak, portage and run challenge, it’s time to discover if these top contestants are worthy of the name All-Stars.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 1 Ep. 5 - Pushing to the Max
programme.desc: Mission training intensifies with live-ammo run-and-shoot drills, barriers, cover and an extreme rope course as the leaderboard comes under pressure.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 1 Ep. 6 - It Pays To Be A Winner
programme.desc: The 32 tackle a dangerous desert-and-tunnel navigation challenge for a major prize while mistakes and growing tension begin to stir drama in the ranks.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 1 Ep. 7 - Roll The Dice
programme.desc: A live-fire mobile combat drill in a canyon leads to a high-risk 700-yard pinnacle shot, where top competitors can gamble valuable points for a big payoff.

programme.title: Push

Hiding in Hong Kong's underworld, Nick assembles a band of rogue psychics dedicated to destroying Division. Together with Cassie, a teenage clairvoyant, Nick goes in search of a missing girl and a stolen suitcase that could be the key to accomplishing their mutual goal.

programme.title: Project Ithaca
programme.desc: A malevolent alien species has been abducting humans for decades...possibly centuries. Their endgame: to harvest enough human emotional energy to open a wormhole through which their spacecrafts can pass and conquer our world.

programme.desc: A country music singer meets an untimely demise and learns she can't enter heaven until she performs a good deed on Earth. She must find a mother for a widowed father and his two children.

programme.title: The Thing from Another World
programme.desc: When scientist Dr. Carrington (Robert Cornthwaite) reports a UFO near his North Pole research base, the Air Force sends in a team under Capt. Patrick Hendry (Kenneth Tobey) to investigate. What they find is a wrecked spaceship and a humanoid creature (James Arness) frozen in the ice. They bring their discovery back to the base, but Carrington and Hendry disagree over what to do with it. Meanwhile, the creature is accidentally thawed and begins wreaking havoc.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. Holed up in a North Carolina truck stop, a group of survivors must fend for themselves against a mass of homicidal trucks. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

programme.title: I, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Two centuries after Dr. Frankenstein assembles and reanimates his creature, Adam is still living. He becomes embroiled in a war between two immortal races: gargoyles, the traditional protectors of mankind, and evil demons. Since Adam is neither human nor demon, gargoyle Queen Leonore and demon Prince Naberius each want him for their own purposes. It is up to Adam to discover his inner humanity and the reason for his continued existence.

programme.title: End Time Prophecy of the Popes
programme.desc: Saint Malachy, an obscure Irish archbishop from the 12th century, is said to have written a text called 'The Prophecy of the Popes'. In this he foretold the end of the papacy, the destruction of Rome, and the Last Judgment. Is this only one more apocalyptic vision? Another 'end of the world' tale like the one people have imagined in the Mayan calendar? Perhaps not.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: September 11, 2001 is a date etched in world history. One researcher says the Bible Code warned of the attack. Is this possible? Does the Bible provide prophetic information?
